name: Ore ga Onna de Dorei Goshujin-sama ni Houshi Suru no
original_name: 俺が女で奴隷でご主人様に奉仕するの
source:
A man in debt agrees to anything, and ends up locked in a room and turned into a woman.
Next thing she knows, she's servicing her new lord with her lips and hands.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ083268.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
